pages.text: Press $(k:key.comminutioncraft.wrench_mode) while holding the Wrench to switch modes:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Rotate$(): turn a block.$(li)$(bold)Cables$(): cut or restore one arm of a cable or pipe.$(li)$(bold)Configure$(): click a machine face to change it, or a multiblock port to switch it between Input and Output. $(bold)Sneak$()-click picks a machine up.
Mining a machine with a pickaxe drops it plain. Picking it up with the Wrench keeps its stored power, its settings and its upgrades.
